purpose: Teach Bossman to preserve nested market regimes across multiple horizons instead of collapsing everything into one label.

seven_day.interpretation: Broad recovery / leverage rebuild relative to the FOMC deleveraging area.

local_now.interpretation: Local deterioration inside a stronger higher-horizon recovery.

core_rule: Never collapse conflicting horizons into one market regime. A bearish short-term regime can coexist with a bullish higher-horizon recovery.
output_rule: Telegram deep analysis should display one regime per available horizon, then summarize whether short-term flow is aligned with or counter-trend to the higher-horizon structure.
training_lessons: Short-term bearish leverage expansion does not automatically invalidate a 7D recovery structure.
Higher-horizon recovery is supported when price, CVD and OI are materially above prior event-deleveraging baselines.
Use the nearest structural level to distinguish correction from broader regime failure.
A dPOC hold/reclaim can preserve higher-horizon bullish structure even during local bearish flow.
A dPOC loss plus failed reclaim and continued CVD deterioration/OI expansion increases evidence that the correction is broadening.
Do not compare incompatible CVD/OI series across providers or settings.

future_implementation.multi_horizon_engine: Extend horizons from 15m/30m/60m to NOW/15m/30m/60m/4h/24h/7D where sufficient compatible history exists.
future_implementation.deep_report: Include alignment field such as ALIGNED_BULLISH, ALIGNED_BEARISH, or COUNTER_TREND_PULLBACK.
future_implementation.promotion_rule: Promote after current screenshot values and 7D comparison are independently verified from compatible stored observations.
